title: 18693 - 18693/P2261/008801
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Boost Pressure Control Valve (N249) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Boost Pressure Control Valve (N249)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Boost Pressure Control Valve (N249)
technicalNotes:
Visually check the N249 valve for a split diaphragm and replace the faulty component with the latest revision as per the parts management system and various TSB/TPIs which include but are not limited to:
VW TPIs 2023024 and  2016986
